summary: Retest of the iteration_1 fixes. Backend: 26 of 26 pass in test_cofounderbay_api.py (20 regression + 6 new Fix 6 tests). test_zz_rate_limit.py: 1 pass, 1 fail (X-Forwarded-For spoof bypass). Frontend in demo mode: Fix 1 (no raw Markdown: cold-email answer and /pitch use '• ' with no ** or #, and no talk about formatting), Fix 2 (drafts kept: pitch went 6/8 -> 5/8, not 0/8, and Founder Tools still shows the other slides done), Fix 3 (the 'Open this slide' button goes to /founder-tools?tab=pitch&slide=problem and the Problem slide 02 is selected), Fix 4 (incorporation already done -> no Confirm card; EIN -> Confirm/Cancel/Undo testids work), Fix 5 ('AI Studio · audit' tag stable across 3 runs), the new assistant-input/assistant-send testids, the ledger (Applied 1 / Undone 1 / Cancelled 1) and the AI profile review (summary, strengths and gaps, 3 actions, no **) all PASS.

minor.issue: The rate limit can still be bypassed. caller_key takes the FIRST X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client controls. Even with the bucket exhausted (429), a request with a forged 'X-Forwarded-For: 10.9.x.7' got 400 (it passed the limiter). Use the right-most hop added by the trusted ingress (or X-Real-IP / the last XFF entry) instead of split(',')[0].
A body that is not an object ('[1]') or is not JSON returns 500 (body.get on a list / JSONDecodeError). It should return 400.
A body that is not JSON ('bad') returns 500 because request.json() raises. It should return 400 or 422. Nested values -> 422 and a flat dict -> 200 work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: After setting the Problem slide to a one-line sentence, the pitch count drops 6/8 -> 5/8 because the new text is rated in-progress. This is working as designed (drafts are no longer wiped), but the request expected 'same or higher'.

pitchSlide comes from ?slide= only in the useState initializer. If the user is already on /founder-tools and a chat link changes ?slide=, the selected slide will not update (no effect on searchParams). This was not hit in the test because the link was clicked from the Dashboard.

issues: After Undo, the earlier Claude-reworded bubble still says 'EIN is now marked as done... 3 of 5' above 'Undone.', which is misleading.

Claude rewording of router answers adds unrequested content: the incorporation 'already done' reply drifts into milestones, and the pitch-set confirm warns about a Lean Canvas mismatch. That is helpful but long.
Still inconsistent: Profile strength 90% vs the AI review's gaps; the headline says 'FinTech' while the venture is EcoFlow water recycling (carried over from iteration_1).

action_items: caller_key: do not trust the client-supplied first X-Forwarded-For entry; use the ingress-appended (right-most) hop
ai_generate / tenant patch: return 400 for a body that is not JSON or not an object instead of 500
Optional: sync FounderTools pitchSlide with searchParams in a useEffect
Optional: after Undo, mark or replace the stale 'now marked as done' bubble text
critical_code_review_comments: server.py plain_text only strips **/__, # headings, */- bullets and inline code. Single *italic*, numbered-list markdown and [link](url) pass through. This is acceptable given the system prompt also asks for plain text.
The rate limiter runs before body validation, so invalid calls still use up the bucket. That is fine, and useful for testing without spending on the LLM.
